visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male performer with styled grey hair wearing a black t-shirt plays a distinctive spiky white electric guitar on a stage under intense blue and white spotlights. The stadium atmosphere is thick with atmospheric blue smoke. (2) The perspective shifts to the audience area where numerous people are seen from the back, holding up smartphones and glowing green and blue light sticks. A woman in the foreground wears a black bucket hat and sunglasses, holding a light stick while gesturing towards the camera. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a black quilted leather handbag resting on a black suitcase being pulled across a tiled floor. This is followed by a shot of a silver minivan parked outdoors near an airport-like terminal, where a woman in a grey hoodie and baseball cap checks her phone. (4) Two paper concert tickets for the 'Evolution' concert on April 27, 2025, in Hong Kong are displayed prominently. Subsequent scenes show a car driving past a large promotional billboard at night and the modern, illuminated exterior of the Kai Tak Sports Park stadium. (5) Inside the venue, the woman in the bucket hat takes a selfie. The camera pans across a large standing area filled with fans dancing and cheering. The artist is seen again on stage, smiling and interacting with the crowd while playing his guitar and pointing towards the fans.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a spontaneous, last-minute journey to attend Nicholas Tse's 'Evolution' concert in Hong Kong. It aims to share the excitement and success of the 'pursuit of a star' (追星) by highlighting the rapid timeline from booking flights to entering the venue and enjoying the live performance.
